items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: And Lee Collins is another trumpet player from here. He's a wonderful trumpet player. He had his own group at that time.

ctx.x: He was a powerful alto player at that time. He could blow the roof off the house. And Lee Collins is another trumpet player from here. He's a wonderful trumpet player. He had his own group at that time. He had a small group. And South Stan had one of the best bands in the south at that time. It was swinging.
